entries.title: Psalms 68:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Of David. A Psalm: a Song.>> Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered, and let them that hate him flee before him.

entries.title: Psalms 68:2
segments: As smoke is driven, thou wilt drive them away; as wax melteth before the fire, the wicked shall perish at the presence of God.

entries.title: Psalms 68:3
segments: But the righteous shall rejoice: they shall exult before God and be glad with joy.

entries.title: Psalms 68:4
segments: Sing unto God, sing forth his name; cast up a way for him that rideth in the deserts: his name is Jah; and rejoice before him.

entries.title: Psalms 68:5
segments: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

entries.title: Psalms 68:6
segments: God maketh the solitary into families; those that were bound he bringeth out into prosperity: but the rebellious dwell in a parched [land].

entries.title: Psalms 68:7
segments: ¶O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness--(Selah) --

entries.title: Psalms 68:8
segments: The earth trembled, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God, yon Sinai, at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 68:9
segments: Thou, O God, didst pour a plentiful rain upon thine inheritance, and when it was weary thou strengthenedst it.

entries.title: Psalms 68:10
segments: Thy flock hath dwelt therein: thou hast prepared in thy goodness, for the afflicted, O God!

entries.title: Psalms 68:11
segments: The Lord gives the word: great the host of the publishers.

entries.title: Psalms 68:12
segments: Kings of armies flee; they flee, and she that tarrieth at home divideth the spoil.

entries.title: Psalms 68:13
segments: Though ye have lain among the sheepfolds, [ye shall be as] wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with green gold.

entries.title: Psalms 68:14
segments: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it became snow-white as Zalmon.

entries.title: Psalms 68:15
segments: ¶[As] mount Bashan is the mount of God, a many-peaked mountain, [as] mount Bashan.

entries.title: Psalms 68:16
segments: Why do ye look with envy, ye many-peaked mountains, upon the mount that God hath desired for his abode? yea, Jehovah will dwell [there] for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 68:17
segments: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, thousands upon thousands; the Lord is among them: it is a Sinai in holiness.

entries.title: Psalms 68:18
segments: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts in Man, and even [for] the rebellious, for the dwelling [there] of Jah Elohim.

entries.title: Psalms 68:19
segments: Blessed be the Lord: day by day doth he load us [with good], the *God who is our salvation. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 68:20
segments: Our *God is the *God of salvation; and with Jehovah, the Lord, are the goings forth [even] from death.

entries.title: Psalms 68:21
segments: Verily God will smite the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of him that goeth on still in his trespasses.

entries.title: Psalms 68:22
segments: ¶The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring [them] again from the depth of the sea;

entries.title: Psalms 68:23
segments: That thou mayest dip thy foot in blood: the tongue of thy dogs has its portion from enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 68:24
segments: They have seen thy goings, O God, the goings of my *God, my King, in the sanctuary.

entries.title: Psalms 68:25
segments: The singers went before, the players on stringed instruments after, in the midst of maidens playing on tabrets.

entries.title: Psalms 68:26
segments: In the congregations bless ye God, the Lord, --[ye] from the fountain of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 68:27
segments: There is little Benjamin, their ruler; the princes of Judah, their company; the princes of Zebulun, the princes of Naphtali.

entries.title: Psalms 68:28
segments: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.

entries.title: Psalms 68:29
segments: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.

entries.title: Psalms 68:30
segments: Rebuke the beast of the reeds, the assembly of the strong, with the calves of the peoples: [every one] submitteth himself with pieces of silver. Scatter the peoples that delight in war.

entries.title: Psalms 68:31
segments: Great ones shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall quickly stretch out her hands unto God.

entries.title: Psalms 68:32
segments: ¶Ye kingdoms of the earth, sing unto God; sing psalms of the Lord, (Selah,)

entries.title: Psalms 68:33
segments: Of him that rideth upon the heavens, the heavens which are of old: lo, he uttereth his voice, a mighty voice.

entries.title: Psalms 68:34
segments: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency is over Israel, and his strength is in the clouds.

entries.title: Psalms 68:35
segments: Terrible art thou, O God, out of thy sanctuaries, --the *God of Israel! He it is that giveth strength and might unto the people. Blessed be God!
